text:
incident-bot: PAGER -> @oncall: Sev2 - smart-routing fallback loop detected. Multiple requests flowing between us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 -> us-west-2 due to policy mismatch; increased 500s and tool-calling failures. Auto-escalate to oncall.

maria: ack - investigating. seeing a spike in model errors and a routing loop in the trace. attaching first logs.

raj: logs show repeated attempts to route to model 'gptx-3b-quant' which returns: `\"error\": \"model_incompatible: tool_calling not supported for quantized variants\"`. fallback policy is configured to prefer "nearest_compatible" so it keeps flipping regions and variants.

maria: exact trace snippet: ```
TRACE: request_id=abc123 route_attempt=1 region=us-west-2 variant=fp16 success=false error=model_incompatible
TRACE: request_id=abc123 route_attempt=2 region=eu-west-1 variant=quant success=false error=missing_tool_support
TRACE: request_id=abc123 route_attempt=3 region=us-west-2 variant=fp16 ... loop
```

kevin: creating mitigation -> disabling automated fallback for the affected route and pinning to fp16 variant in us-east-1. running: `redwoodctl routes update --name /generate --set fallback_policy=none` then `redwoodctl routes pin --name /generate --model gptx-3b-fp16 --region us-east-1`

ops-bot: executed `routes update` (job id 7890). config diff: ```- fallback_policy: nearest_compatible
+ fallback_policy: none
```

maria: rolling config out to prod canary (5% traffic). monitoring error-rate and p50 latency.

emily: heads-up - 3 customers filed errors (widgets-service) re: malformed tool-call responses. CS notified and sending status.

kevin: immediate impact: 12% increase in 500s on /generate over last 10m, ~1200 requests affected. fallback loop caused tool_calling requests to hit quant variant which returns schema errors.

raj: root-cause hypothesis: compatibility matrix in routing service missing `supports_tool_calling=false` flag for quantized variants. routing policy engine considered quant variant compatible because it only checked model family & context length. we need matrix update + add explicit capability flags.

maria: short-term mitigation applied. next steps: 1) patch compatibility matrix (raj), 2) add unit test in routing policy for tool_calling flag (kevin), 3) run synthetic test harness across regions to validate no loop (maria).

kevin: taking handoff. I'll be on for the next 2 hours. monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/d/alerts/route-loops (post-canary).

emily: posting customer-facing note: "We've applied a targeted routing configuration to stop repeated fallbacks; engineering is rolling a fix. We'll follow up in 2 hours." :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: metric update: error-rate returned to baseline after canary started (~+8m). watching for regressions.

raj: patch created: PR #452 - adds supports_tool_calling flag for quantized variants and expands routing checks to include capability intersection.

maria: brief postmortem tasks added to tracker: link https://board.redwood.ai/INC-178850. include owning teams: routing-service, model-onboarding, cust-succ.

kevin: if anything pops while I'm oncall DM me, otherwise I'll handoff at 22:00 UTC to maria for follow-ups.

incident-bot: Incident state -> acknowledged -> mitigation in place -> monitoring.

maria: closing thread for now; will reopen if errors > baseline for 15m. thanks all :heart:
